properties.w: An Anglo-French condominium from 1906, until independence as Vanuatu in 1980.
British New Guinea until 1906, then run by Australia.
Under Japanese control from 1940. In September 1945 Ho Chi Minh declared Vietnam independent in Hanoi while British and French troops retook the south; war with France followed in 1946.
Annexed by the United States in 1898; a US territory until it became a state in 1959.
Part of the colony of Madagascar until 1946, when the islands became a French overseas territory of their own.
Aden and its protectorates were British until South Yemen's independence in 1967.
The west of German Togoland, a British mandate from 1922 run with the Gold Coast; it joined Ghana in 1957.
Ottoman land under British rule from 1878, annexed by Britain in 1914 and a crown colony from 1925 until independence in 1960.
A sultanate under British protection from 1890 until 1963.
Italian from 1912, under British military rule from 1945, and Greek from 1947.
A British Crown dependency, not part of the United Kingdom.
German New Guinea until 1914; an Australian mandate of the League of Nations from December 1920 (Japanese-occupied in 1942–45).
Occupied in four zones by the Allies from 1945 until 1955; its provisional government was recognised in October 1945.
The American, British and French sectors of Berlin, occupied from July 1945; the four powers governed the city together.
A British colony from 1813 until independence in 1964.
German until 1915, then a League of Nations mandate run by South Africa, which held it until Namibia's independence in 1990.
Spain's protectorate zones in Morocco, in the north and the far south (1912–1956; the southern one until 1958). With Ifni, Spanish from 1934.
Occupied by the Allies, chiefly the United States, from September 1945 until 1952.
The Kwantung Leased Territory, Japanese from 1905, taken by the Soviet army in August 1945. The Soviet Union kept Port Arthur as a naval base until 1955.
Japan's League of Nations mandate, taken by the United States in 1944–45; a UN trust territory under US rule from 1947.
A Japanese colony from 1895; run by the Republic of China from October 1945.
Ruled by the Brooke family under British protection; a British colony from 1946 until it joined Malaysia in 1963.
Run by the British North Borneo Company until 1946, then a British colony until it joined Malaysia in 1963.
The east of German Togoland, run by France (a League of Nations mandate from 1922); independent in 1960.
